title: Lady Bird Deeds and Transfer on Death Deeds by State, 50 States and DC (2026)

fields.name: Jurisdiction name.
fields.instrument_name: What the non-probate deed is called where it has authority: lady bird deed (enhanced life estate deed), transfer on death deed, beneficiary deed, or neither.
fields.lady_bird_deed_recognized: yes = primary authority (statute, court decision or Medicaid agency rule) recognizes a deed reserving to the owner a life estate with the power to sell without the remainder's consent; no = a court has said the state does not recognize it; unclear = no primary authority found.
fields.lady_bird_authority_type: statute, case_law, agency_rule, court_declined, or unclear.
fields.tod_deed_recognized: yes or no: a statute lets real property pass at death by a recorded revocable deed.
fields.tod_deed_statute: Citation of the transfer on death or beneficiary deed statute.
fields.tod_deed_uniform_act: yes if based on the Uniform Real Property Transfer on Death Act, no if a home-grown statute, n/a if none.
fields.what_to_use: One sentence on which instrument an owner there would use.
fields.recovery_scope: Medicaid estate recovery scope: probate_only or expanded.
fields.lady_bird_deed_recovery: Whether Medicaid estate recovery can reach a home passed by lady bird deed: reachable, not_reachable, unclear.
fields.tod_deed_recovery: Same for a home passed by transfer on death deed; n/a where there is no statute.
fields.last_verified: Date the row was last checked against its sources.
fields.confidence: high, medium or low, from the source dataset.

provenance: Derived from the StepUpLaw Medicaid estate recovery and home-transfer deed dataset (verified 2026-09-23, corrected 2026-09-28) and the 2026-10-07 sweep of every court in the local CourtListener corpus for the terms lady bird deed, ladybird deed and enhanced life estate.
